query:
UPDATE services SET
  shortDesc = 'Fix your sewer line without digging up your property. We use UV-cured CIPP lining, ElastoFlake spray coating, and spot patch repair to restore pipes from the inside, backed by a 20-year warranty.',
  longDesc = 'When a sewer pipe is cracked, root-invaded, or corroding, the old answer was to dig a trench across your yard or driveway and replace it. We have a better option for most situations.

Our trenchless repair program uses three proven technologies depending on what the camera shows. For full-length pipe rehabilitation, we use CIPP UV lining with the Sewertronics Speedylight+ system. A felt liner saturated with UA resin (urethane acrylate/methacrylate) is inserted into the existing pipe, positioned precisely using the system''s integrated high-resolution CCTV camera, and then cured in minutes using UV-LED light. The result is a seamless, jointless new pipe inside the old one, with no joints for roots to re-enter. The liner material is resistant to common household wastewater and chemicals, has minimal shrinkage, and adheres to most pipe hosts.

For localized damage, we use the PipePatch spot repair system. A fibreglass mat impregnated with silicate epoxy resin is wrapped around a packer, positioned at the damaged section, inflated, and cured at ambient temperature in one to three hours. This is ideal when only a short section of pipe is compromised and full lining is not warranted.

For pipes that need a protective coating rather than structural repair, we use ElastoFlake spray-in-place polyurethane coating. This smooth, highly elastic material limits buildup, resists pressure and chemicals, and is certified by VTT Finland, DIBt Germany, and Teknologisk Institut Denmark. It works on plastic, cast iron, copper, concrete, and most other pipe materials.

All trenchless work is backed by our 20-year warranty. A camera inspection is the first step to determine which method is right for your pipe.',
  benefits = '[{"title":"UV-Cured CIPP Lining","desc":"The Sewertronics Speedylight+ uses UV-LED technology to cure a UA resin liner in minutes, creating a seamless pipe inside the existing one with no joints for roots to enter."},{"title":"Spot Patch Repair","desc":"The PipePatch system repairs localized damage in one to three hours using silicate epoxy resin, without requiring full-length lining or excavation."},{"title":"ElastoFlake Spray Coating","desc":"Certified polyurethane coating rehabilitates corroded pipes from the inside, improving flow and resisting chemicals. Works on cast iron, PVC, copper, concrete, and more."},{"title":"No Driveway or Yard Damage","desc":"All three methods require only small access points. Your landscaping, driveway, and patio remain completely undisturbed."}]',
  metaTitle = 'Trenchless Pipe Repair London ON | UV CIPP Lining | Discount Drain',
  metaDesc = 'Trenchless sewer repair in London Ontario using UV-cured CIPP lining, spot patch, and ElastoFlake coating. No digging, 20-year warranty. Call Discount Drain: 519-451-8342.'
WHERE slug = 'trenchless-pipe-repair';
